Package neqsim.mcp.runners

Class ChemistryRunner

java.lang.Object
neqsim.mcp.runners.ChemistryRunner
public class ChemistryRunner extends Object
Stateless chemistry-and-integrity runner for MCP integration.

Exposes the open standards-traceable chemistry stack — electrolyte scale prediction, mechanistic corrosion (NORSOK M-506 + Nesic mass transfer + Langmuir inhibitor), Langmuir inhibitor isotherm dosing, packed-bed H2S scavenger breakthrough, activity-consistent electrolyte scale equilibrium, and fail-closed Pitzer dataset qualification — as JSON-driven analyses usable by AI agents over the Model Context Protocol.

All analyses follow the same pattern: agents pass an analysis field naming the routine and a flat object with the required parameters; the runner returns {status, analysis, data, provenance} on success or a structured error object with a remediation hint on failure.

    • runElectrolyteScaleEquilibrium

      private static com.google.gson.JsonObject runElectrolyteScaleEquilibrium(com.google.gson.JsonObject input)
      Runs the authoritative single-pure-mineral electrolyte equilibrium operation and reports its scientific gates.

      The adapter adds no thermodynamic equation or parameter. Pitzer GE and electrolyte CPA retain distinct parameter semantics while sharing the public ThermodynamicOperations.precipitateScale(String) operation.

      Parameters:
      input - chemistry analysis input
      Returns:
      precipitation ledger, aqueous-state diagnostics, and qualification boundary

    • runElectrolyteMultiScaleEquilibrium

      private static com.google.gson.JsonObject runElectrolyteMultiScaleEquilibrium(com.google.gson.JsonObject input)
      Runs simultaneous competing pure-mineral equilibrium against the selected electrolyte model.

      This is a thin JSON/MCP view over ThermodynamicOperations.precipitateScales(String...). It is distinct from the concentration-based multiMineralScale screening analysis and adds no thermodynamic equation, Ksp, or interaction parameter.

      Parameters:
      input - chemistry analysis input
      Returns:
      deterministic solid ledger, complementarity, aqueous-state, and qualification evidence

    • runPitzerQualification

      private static com.google.gson.JsonObject runPitzerQualification(com.google.gson.JsonObject input)
      Reports active-topology coverage and scientific qualification from the authoritative SystemPitzer APIs.

      This setup/publication view performs no flash and adopts no parameter. Component amounts are system moles; temperature is K and pressure is bara. The explicit dataset selector prevents a caller from confusing source availability with observable-specific qualification.

      Parameters:
      input - chemistry analysis input
      Returns:
      deterministic qualification decision and evidence, apart from envelope timing/provenance
